help.goal: Bank more than half the 48 seeds in your store — the big pit on your right.
steps: Wait until the top line says your move.
Tap any pit in your own row (the near one) that still has seeds.
The seeds drop one per pit going left to right along your row, into your store, and on round the board.
Your opponent's store is skipped — you never feed it.
The pits that just got a seed stay lit, so you can see where the sowing ended.
notes: Land your last seed in your own store and it says GO AGAIN — take another turn straight away.
Land your last seed in an empty pit on your own side and you capture it plus everything in the pit facing it.
When either row runs out, the other player banks the seeds still on their side and the biggest store wins.
Play alone and a bot takes the seat: Easy sows anywhere, Normal grabs free turns, Sharp counts six moves ahead.
